items.title: Commission unconditionally approves Deutsche Börse's acquisition of Allfunds
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 27 Nov 2026 The European Commission has unconditionally approved, under the EU Merger Regulation, the proposed acquisition by Deutsche Börse of Allfunds.

items.title: The Government Successfully Forfeited Over $670,000 in Cryptocurrency Linked to an Online Investment Scam
items.summary: Chief U.S. District Judge Brenda K. Sannes issued an order November 16, 2026, forfeiting $674,469.58 worth of cryptocurrency seized by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to the government in connection with an investigation of an online cryptocurrency scam affecting multiple victims.

items.title: Justice Department Awards Federal Grant to Hire Deputies in Bay County
items.summary: Tallahassee, Florida — Through the Office of Community Oriented Policing Services (COPS Office), the Department of Justice today announced it has awarded nearly $150 million under the 2026 COPS Hiring Program (CHP), including $3.125 million to Bay County.
